We’ll start with the core outcome: turn your flat browser list into a useful personal library where saving requires little effort and finding a link later is easy.

I understand the direction as:

- Pasting a link automatically fills in its title and short description.
- Search and tags help you retrieve saved links quickly.
- Links can be marked “read later,” annotated with a personal note, and archived without permanent deletion.

Is that the right overall goal, or is sharing and collaborating with other people also part of what you’re trying to achieve?
